$comment: Roadmap phase 2 boot matrix, shared by test/boot-regression.e2e-spec.ts (the built entrypoint) and scripts/certify/boot-matrix.sh (the release candidate image, roadmap 9.12). validProduction passes every configuration rule; each case overrides one variable (null = unset) and must refuse to start with [Bootstrap FATAL] and the reason, before anything dials the database or Redis.

cases.label: no NODE_ENV
cases.reason: NODE_ENV must be set to development, test or production

cases.label: a blank JWT_SECRET
cases.note: Blank rather than absent: with NODE_ENV=production the committed template fills an absent JWT_SECRET with its placeholder, which is the next case.

cases.label: AUTH_DISABLED=true in production
cases.reason: AUTH_DISABLED=true is only accepted when NODE_ENV is development or test

cases.label: a relative STORAGE_ROOT
cases.note: Roadmap 7.5: a relative root would depend on the working directory of whoever starts the process.

cases.label: LOG_LEVEL=debug in production
cases.reason: logLevel is "debug": production prints at most the "log" level
cases.note: Roadmap 7.6: no debug output in production.

cases.label: a placeholder SENTRY_DSN
cases.note: Roadmap 7.6: a placeholder DSN would silently disable error tracking.
